title: atragene occidentalis var. dissecta
intro: Atragene occidentalis var. dissecta, commonly known as Meadow Saxifrage, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Saxifragaceae family. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Saxifrage involve soothing skin irritations, calming digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
